coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 6 ground-truth variable fields (33%): use of Docta for label detection/correction and comparison of raw versus Docta-cleaned training data.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces Anthropic Harmless and Red Team datasets with sentiment/topic benchmarks and BERT/GPT-2 with DeBERTa/RoBERTa. Uses a generic gold test set rather than the ChatGPT Cleaned and Human Sampled evaluation subsets; ChatGPT/human label validation is not equivalent to testing predictive performance on those subsets. Although Macro-F1 and predictive performance are measured, they are not for the specified toxicity task or Tables 6–7. Adds unsupported controls and credibility metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that Docta-cleaned training data should significantly improve F1 on both specified evaluation subsets, supporting improved label credibility through mitigation of raw-label inconsistencies.
